company.shortDescription: Invoca, the recognized leader in conversation intelligence AI for marketing, e-commerce, and contact center teams
company.description: Invoca is the recognized leader in conversation intelligence AI that enables marketing, e-commerce, and contact center teams to drive efficient and profitable revenue growth by unlocking actionable insights from customer conversations. Through deep integrations with leading technology platforms, teams can turn conversation data into automated action to enhance every digital touchpoint and human interaction, leading to better experiences, more conversions, and higher revenue. With Invoca, top consumer brands, including AutoNation, DIRECTV, Mayo Clinic, Mutual of Omaha, and Verizon, experience unbelievable results powered by undeniable data. Invoca has raised $184M from leading venture capitalists, including Upfront Ventures, Accel, Silver Lake Waterman, H.I.G. Growth Partners, and Salesforce Ventures. For more information, visit www.invoca.com.

aiResearchSummary.text: Invoca is researching machine learning approaches for analyzing and classifying spoken interactions. Work titled topic based semantic search of electronic documents based on machine learning and pitman yor process topic modeling pre seeded by keyword groupings focuses on topic models for call transcripts. Dialog analysis using voice energy level and automatic classification of phone calls using representation learning based on a hierarchical feature model support call analytics. A performance score determiner and supervised topic modeling training generation round out model evaluation and data creation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $83,000,000, or 41.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,541,415 to $1,100,000,000, a 104.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
